questions.scenario: After a long run in the park, John is breathing heavily.
questions.question:
Friend: Are you tired?
John: ___________________
options: Yes, I am. I need to rest.
Yes, you are. I need to rest.
No, I am not. I am very tired
Yes, I do. I need to rest.
questions.explanation: 問句 Are you...?，自己的回答必須切換為 I am。由於 John 剛跑完步且需要休息，回答 Yes 是符合邏輯的。選項 B 人稱沒有轉換；選項 C 前後矛盾 (No 卻說我很累)；選項 D 錯用助動詞 do。
questions.commonMisconception: 回答時沒有把 You 轉換成 I；或是簡答的 Yes/No 判斷與後面的補充說明邏輯互相矛盾。

questions.scenario: A little girl dropped her favorite ice cream on the floor.
questions.question:
Mom: Oh dear! ___________________
Girl: Yes, I am. My ice cream is gone.
questions.explanation: 根據情境 (冰淇淋掉在地上) 以及她回答 Yes, I am.，可以推測媽媽問的是『難過嗎？』(Are you sad?)。選項 B 不符合情境；選項 C Be 動詞搭配錯誤；選項 D 把形容詞當一般動詞配了 Do。
questions.commonMisconception: 將情緒形容詞 (sad/happy) 當成了動詞，而使用助動詞 Do 來提問 (Do you sad?)。

questions.scenario: Two students are waiting for their test results.
questions.question:
Student A: I got an A! I am so happy.
Student B: I got an F. ___________________
questions.explanation: Student B 考了 F (不及格)，情境上應該是不開心的。正確的 Be 動詞+否定形容詞為 I am not happy.。選項 B 和 D 誤用了助動詞 (don't/doesn't) 來否定形容詞；選項 C 語意矛盾。
questions.commonMisconception: 以為所有的否定句都是在詞彙前面加 don't (把 I am not happy 寫成 I don't happy)。

questions.scenario: A boy sees his brother stomping his feet and yelling.
questions.question:
Boy: Look at Tim. Is he angry?
Dad: ___________________
options: No, he isn't. He is angry.
Yes, he does. He is very mad
Yes, he is. He is very mad.
Yes, I am. I am very angry.
questions.explanation: 問句 Is he...? 詢問第三人稱，簡答為 Yes, he is.，且符合 Tim 生氣的情境。選項 B 誤用 does；選項 C 語意前後矛盾；選項 D 錯把人稱換成了 I。
questions.commonMisconception: 被答題習慣制約，一看到 Yes/No 疑問句就想回答 Yes, I am，忘記主語是第三人稱 he。

questions.scenario: A teacher is handing out prizes to the winning team.
questions.question:
Teacher: You won the game! Are you happy?
Team: ___________________
options: No, we aren't. We are happy!
Yes, they are. They are happy
Yes, we do. We are happy!
Yes, we are. We are happy!
questions.explanation: 老師對著整個團隊問 Are you (複數：你們)...?，團隊必須以第一人稱複數 we (我們) 來回答。選項 A 最為正確。選項 B 錯用 they；選項 C 誤搭 do；選項 D 自相矛盾。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略了 you 在英文裡可以是單數的『你』或複數的『你們』，導致回答時無法適當切換為 we。

questions.scenario: Before going to bed, a mother checks on her son.
questions.question:
Mom: It's ten o'clock. ___________________
Son: Yes, I am. Good night, Mom.
questions.explanation: 從道晚安 (Good night) 可以推測媽媽在問他是不是累了 (tired)。選項 B 情境不合；選項 C 把 tired 當動詞配了 Do；選項 D 是 Be 動詞與主詞配對錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 將 tired 當做動詞使用而選擇了 Do you tired 的錯誤語法。

questions.scenario: Two girls are talking about a sad movie they just watched.
questions.question:
Girl A: The movie is so sad.
Girl B: ___________________
Girl A: Yes, let's watch a funny one.
questions.explanation: 因為電影很令人難過，朋友自然會關心對方『妳也難過嗎？』(Are you sad, too?)。選項 B 語境不合；選項 C, D 為嚴重文法錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合前一句話的情緒背景，選出能讓對話合理延續的問句。

questions.scenario: A brother takes his sister's favorite toy without asking.
questions.question:
Sister: Give it back to me!
Mom: Oh no. ___________________
Brother: I'm sorry, Mom.
questions.explanation: 妹妹的玩具被搶走大喊『還給我！』，媽媽向哥哥陳述『她非常生氣』。主詞 she 的 Be 動詞是 is。選項 B 誤搭 does；選項 C 語意完全相反；選項 D 錯搭 are。
questions.commonMisconception: 在單純的描述情緒句型中，錯把 Be 動詞 is 換成了 are 或是助動詞 does。

questions.scenario: At a surprise birthday party, everyone shouts 'Surprise!'
questions.question:
Dad: Look at Jason! Is he happy?
Uncle: ___________________
options: Yes, he does. He is smiling.
Yes, I am. I am smiling.
No, he isn't. He is smiling.
Yes, he is. He is smiling.
questions.explanation: 問句 Is he...? 的人稱是第三人稱單數 he，回答必須對稱且符合生日情境。選項 A (是的，他在笑) 完全正確。選項 B 人稱走鐘成 I；選項 C 語意矛盾；選項 D 錯用 does。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒有抓穩問句裡的主詞 he，習慣性地回答 Yes, I am，或是錯用助動詞 does。

questions.scenario: A boy is crying because he lost his balloon.
questions.question:
Woman: What's wrong, little boy? ___________________
Boy: Yes, I am. I lost my red balloon.
questions.explanation: 小孩哭泣是因為弄丟了氣球，所以婦女問的應該是 Are you sad? (你很難過嗎？)。選項 B 語境完全不合；選項 C, D 是標準的語法迷思誘答。
questions.commonMisconception: 面對外在的表徵 (crying) 無法順利轉換為對應的情緒形容詞 (sad)，或者文法結構觀念薄弱。
